name: Progressive training by scales of Gaussians
definition: A strategy to focus on low-frequency details during early training stages by controlling the low-pass filter in the rasterization stage, preventing artifacts from Gaussians becoming smaller than a single pixel.
summary: Progressive training by scales of Gaussians prevents rendering artifacts by enforcing a minimum projected area through covariance regularization, differing from standard 3D Gaussian Splatting by using a scale-dependent low-pass filter to prioritize coarse structure learning.
